blockers.title: The packet presents a spent authorization as a live one
blockers.evidence: m0-m2-build-alignment-packet.md:7 and :19 and owner-alignment-record.md:75 state that m0-codex-continuation-handoff.md permits M0-F1 through M0-F5 once the frozen path, revision, and SHA-256 binding arrive. That handoff's cap is exhausted: m0-codex-continuation-handoff.md:70-72 and :86-87 bind it to one non-recurring task expiring after a single run, and m0-codex-continuation-status.json:4,16,19 record the cap consumed and require a new Owner authorization.
blockers.consequence: On acceptance the digest binding arrives and the frozen packet tells an implementer the last precondition for M0-F1 through M0-F5 is satisfied, silently renewing a consumed local cap.
blockers.minimal_fix: Replace the 'permits only after binding' construction in all three places with an explicit statement that the m0-codex-continuation-20260817 authorization is exhausted and that M0-F1 through M0-F5 require a new Owner authorization and start receipt binding the accepted path, revision label, SHA-256, active-time cap, run/read/tool cap, expiry, and halt owner.

blockers.title: directional_only has no reachable trigger except the runtime check and its contract permission is undefined
blockers.evidence: Candidate section 5.3:121 admits directional_only for an incomplete preregistered runtime 'or another frozen sufficiency rule'; no other sufficiency rule exists and none of the 18 checks in section 5.2 covers power, MDE, or precision. Corpus-wide grep for underpowered/MDE/minimum detectable/statistical power returns only final-architecture-spec.md:469 and enterprise-experiment-post-analysis-profile.md:386. final-architecture-spec.md:469 still gates directional_only on an ExperimentReadContract permission that candidate section 5.1:63-76 never defines; alignment/seams.py:140-141 names the same gap.
blockers.consequence: A valid but underpowered read with the preregistered runtime complete passes all 18 checks and, under the closed combination table, can only be eligible + decision_grade. Two competent implementers diverge, firing candidate stop condition 9.
blockers.minimal_fix: Either add a 19th preregistered power/MDE sufficiency check whose material failure maps to blocked + directional_only when no other blocker applies plus the matching section 5.1 contract field, or state that M0 performs no power assessment, that directional_only is reachable only through the runtime check, and delete the permission clause at final-architecture-spec.md:469.

blockers.title: spec:271 requires two ExperimentReadContract fields the candidate omits and no M0 check consumes arm parity
blockers.evidence: final-architecture-spec.md:271 requires 'arm parity fields' and 'legal readiness-combination policy' in ExperimentReadContract. Candidate section 5.1:63-76 omits both. grep -ci 'arm parity' returns 0 for the candidate and 0 for implementation-sequencing.md rows M0-F1 and M0-F3, versus 2 for the spec (:271, :414). final-architecture-spec.md:414 makes arm parity across index generation, serving alias, ACL snapshot, and effective pipeline a required validity input.
blockers.consequence: The freeze binds M0-F1 to a contract field list that contradicts the controlling spec and M0-F3 to an 18-check inventory with no arm-parity check. Accepted finding M9, audited EXACT, does not reach the funded slice. Treatment and control served by different index generations or ACL snapshots produce a real metric delta with no product cause and M0 cannot see it.
blockers.minimal_fix: Rule arm parity M0 or M1 once and make both documents agree. If M0, add the arm-parity fields and the legal readiness-combination policy to candidate section 5.1 and add arm parity to check 5 or as check 19. If M1, delete 'arm parity fields' from final-architecture-spec.md:271 and record the deferral in candidate section 6.

major_findings.title: CoverageGapKind exceeds the frozen taxonomy and was neither seamed nor reported
major_findings.evidence: core/coverage_gap.py:26-37 defines nine kinds against the five-item gloss at wayfinder/freeze-canonical-domain-policy-contracts.md:61, which outranks the spec. The four additions are supported by final-architecture-spec.md:829 and :156, but the continuation handoff section B required an explicit alignment seam or a reported unresolved contract, and m0-codex-continuation-receipt.md section 6 reports neither.
major_findings.consequence: Enum values are digest-bound through CoverageGap.to_canonical() and stable_id at coverage_gap.py:77-87, so every sealed Phase A digest already commits to an unfrozen taxonomy.
major_findings.minimal_fix: Add SEAM-M0-11-COVERAGE-GAP-TAXONOMY naming freeze:61 versus spec:829, or freeze the nine values in candidate section 5.2 and reconcile freeze:61.

major_findings.title: Three Phase A guards are not proven by the 225-case suite
major_findings.evidence: Mutation probes that left the suite at 225 passed: deleting the repeated-receipt-identity rejection at runner/hermetic.py:148-150; deleting self.verify_chain() from RevisionLog.seal() at core/revisions.py:184; making scan_package return () before its loop at tests/_import_graph.py:288.
major_findings.consequence: Latent rather than live: five end-to-end plants of real violations into runtime files were all caught, so the control works today. A future edit breaking the scanner file walk, or an adapter repeating a receipt identity, would land green.
major_findings.minimal_fix: Three tests: a stub adapter returning a duplicate receipt is rejected; seal() raises on a hand-broken chain; and scan_package is proven non-vacuous by injecting the per-file scanner and asserting one invocation per python_files entry.

major_findings.title: B3's reuse inventory still does not exist and it gates M0-F1
major_findings.evidence: No canonical document names metric_registry, schema_catalog, or business-table routing as candidate assets with a read-only reference / clean-room reimplement / direct reuse disposition; only generic basis-table mentions at enterprise-experiment-post-analysis-profile.md:34,95,112. SEAM-M0-08-FIXTURE-BASELINES records the open Owner decision honestly.
major_findings.consequence: Starting M0-F1 without the inventory means re-deriving assets that already exist, or reusing them without the interface, provenance, test, security, and license review O6 requires.
major_findings.minimal_fix: One page, one row per asset, three dispositions, plus the Owner's answer on whether M0 fixtures may be derived from those files. Prerequisite for M0-F1 start, not for packet acceptance.

major_findings.title: 20 of 22 shared VAL-* IDs bind to no sequencing unit
major_findings.evidence: implementation-sequencing.md references only VAL-UI-001 and VAL-UI-101 at seq:59; eval-acceptance-plan.md and final-architecture-spec.md reference none. major_findings.minimal_fix: Add a VAL-* column to the M0-F0 through M0-F5 rows at seq:53-58, or one mapping table in the freeze record.
